subject.title: fix(vault): bound Vault SecretRef JSON response reads to 1 MiB

question: What maximum Vault SecretRef response size should OpenClaw officially support without breaking previously valid Vault values?
rationale: The current 1 MiB wire ceiling is stricter than the upstream storage and listener envelopes, while selecting a different permanent ceiling defines an upgrade-sensitive support contract.

options.title: Define a compatible ceiling
options.body: Choose and document a ceiling derived from the supported Vault payload contract, then test escaped data immediately below and above that boundary.

options.title: Adopt the 1 MiB ceiling
options.body: Explicitly accept that larger existing Vault SecretRefs may fail activation, document the new support limit, and provide upgrade-facing evidence.

options.title: Pause the hard limit
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers can establish a stable size policy rather than landing an arbitrary compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Define a compatible ceiling
recommendation.body: Choose and document a ceiling derived from the supported Vault payload contract, then test escaped data immediately below and above that boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent SecretRef contract and hardening history makes steipete the strongest available owner for this compatibility decision.
